sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Rathmines" (cons 197). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Nine, the area named for Rathmines, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
